text:
Priya Patel: PR ready -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/4877. Hotfix for cache eviction race that's spiking p95 in prod-ci. Small change: add per-key lock on write + extra integ test. Need quick review & merge, rolling canary in 5m. @Sam Kim @Diego Morales @Ava Li can someone take a look?
Sam Kim: on it, will do a pass in ~5
Diego Morales: skimming now, tests look sensible. one comment about narrowing lock scope vs global lock — i'll post inline
Ava Li: if CI green i can approve and merge. is there any db migration or config change?
Priya Patel: no migration. config flag `enable_canary_lock_fix` added (default false) so we can flip it during rollout. canary will be us-west-2 only for first 10 minutes.
Diego Morales: updated review: prefer lock per-shard instead of global to reduce contention. left suggestion in PR.
Sam Kim: saw Diego's suggestion — it's minor. changes are localized, no perf regression in local perf run.
Priya Patel: pushed change addressing per-shard lock, added unit for the edge case. kicking CI again.
oncall-bot: Deploy bot: Canary deploy started for pr:4877 -> env: prod-ci/us-west-2 (canary id: c-17180014).
Sam Kim: CI passed for unit + integ. quick smoke on staging looks good.
Ava Li: Approved. merging after Diego gives final thumbs
Diego Morales: 👍 from me. good to merge.
Priya Patel: merging now, will keep watchers posted.
oncall-bot: Deploy bot: Merge completed for pr:4877. Canary monitoring: p95 latency down ~42% in us-west-2. No error rate increase observed.
Priya Patel: thanks everyone — will promote to full rollout in 30m if canary stays healthy.
